intel.title: [CISA KEV] Adobe Commerce and Magento - Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-75650
廠商: Adobe
產品: Commerce and Magento
漏洞名稱: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
說明: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-11
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此漏洞（CVE-2026-75650）存在於 Adobe Commerce 和 Magento 的模板引擎中，屬於未對特殊元素進行適當過濾的漏洞。遠端攻擊者可利用此漏洞執行任意程式碼（RCE），目前已被 CISA 列入已知被利用漏洞清單（KEV）。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft Windows - Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-81963
廠商: Microsoft
產品: Windows
漏洞名稱: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-22
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Microsoft Windows Update Stack 存在連結追隨漏洞（CVE-2026-81963），允許本地攻擊者將權限提升至 SYSTEM。該漏洞已被證實存在野外活躍攻擊，將直接威脅公司內部的 Windows Server 2019、AD 主機及同仁工作電腦。
analysis.recommendation: 1. 立即針對 Windows Server 2019、AD 主機及同仁 Windows 工作電腦，套用微軟官方發布的最新安全修補程式。2. 建議透過公司現有的 VMware Workspace ONE 系統進行補丁派送與合規性盤點。3. 嚴格限制伺服器與主機的本地登入權限，以降低本地權限提升之風險。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Windows Server 2019
資訊設備-桌上型電腦/筆記型電腦

intel.title: [CISA KEV] N-able N-central - N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability

廠商: N-able
產品: N-central
漏洞名稱: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
說明: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-11
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: N-able N-central 存在靜態程式碼注入漏洞（CVE-2026-86218），允許未經身分驗證的攻擊者進行遠端程式碼執行（RCE）。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），具有極高的潛在威脅。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Microsoft Windows - Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-85880
廠商: Microsoft
產品: Windows
漏洞名稱: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
說明: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-22
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Microsoft Windows 的進階本機程序呼叫 (ALPC) 存在基於堆積的緩衝區溢位漏洞 (CVE-2026-85880)，允許攻擊者在本地提升權限。此漏洞已被納入 CISA KEV 說明已有在野利用，由於公司內部使用 Windows Server 2019 及 Windows 工作電腦，面臨極高被利用風險。
analysis.recommendation: 1. 針對「資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Windows Server 2019」、「AD(Active Directory)主機」及員工 Windows 工作電腦，立即安裝 Microsoft 官方釋出的安全性更新。2. 依據 CISA KEV 要求，於 2026-09-22 前完成修補。3. 限制非必要人員對伺服器的本地存取權限，以降低本地權限提升漏洞的暴露面。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Windows Server 2019
資訊設備-桌上型電腦/筆記型電腦
